_readme: Do NOT replace your generated Packages/manifest.json with this file. Create the project in Unity Hub (Unity 6, 3D/URP or Built-in), then ADD the entries below. Easiest path instead: Window > Package Manager > My Assets > 'Meta XR All-in-One SDK' (free, Asset Store) > Install. That pulls Core + Interaction SDK + Simulator in one go.
_notes: com.meta.xr.sdk.all = Meta XR All-in-One (Core SDK + Interaction SDK + Voice + Simulator). v207 is the version the competition names.
If the scoped registry 404s on your Unity version, just use the Asset Store route above — same packages, same price (free).
After install: Meta > Tools > Project Setup Tool > 'Fix All' for Android. Then Meta > Tools > Building Blocks > add 'Camera Rig' and 'Hand Tracking'.
